This page takes you from the smithers.sh home page to a repository's files, then to signing in with GitHub. It takes about five minutes.

**Before you start:** you need a GitHub account to sign in. To open a private repository, you also need read access to it on GitHub.

## 1. Open smithers.sh

Go to [smithers.sh](https://smithers.sh). **Sign in** (1) is at the top right.

<figure class="docs-shot">
<img src="/images/docs/welcome-home.light.webp" alt="The smithers.sh home page: Sign in at the top right (1) and the command that adds a coding flow to a repository (2)" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="dark:sl-hidden" />
<img src="/images/docs/welcome-home.dark.webp" alt="The smithers.sh home page: Sign in at the top right (1) and the command that adds a coding flow to a repository (2)" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="light:sl-hidden" />
</figure>

## 2. Open a repository

A repository on smithers.sh has the path it has on GitHub: replace `github.com` with `smithers.sh` in the repository's address. For example, `https://smithers.sh/smithersai/vibelang` opens the `smithersai/vibelang` repository.

The repository opens on its files, on the branch shown at the top left (1).

<figure class="docs-shot">
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-repo-home.light.webp" alt="The smithersai/vibelang repository on smithers.sh, open on its file tree: the branch (1) and a folder (2)" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="dark:sl-hidden" />
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-repo-home.dark.webp" alt="The smithersai/vibelang repository on smithers.sh, open on its file tree: the branch (1) and a folder (2)" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="light:sl-hidden" />
</figure>

If smithers.sh doesn't have the repository yet, the page says so and asks you to sign in with GitHub.

## 3. Read a file

Choose a folder (2) to open it, or a file to read it. The file's path (1) is at the top. Choose the repository's name in the path to go back to its files.

<figure class="docs-shot">
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-file.light.webp" alt="package.json in smithersai/vibelang on smithers.sh, with the file's path at the top (1)" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="dark:sl-hidden" />
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-file.dark.webp" alt="package.json in smithersai/vibelang on smithers.sh, with the file's path at the top (1)" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="light:sl-hidden" />
</figure>

## 4. Sign in with GitHub

Choose **Sign in**. GitHub asks you to sign in, then to authorize Smithers to read your account and email address and to access your repositories.

<figure class="docs-shot">
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-sign-in.light.webp" alt="GitHub's sign-in page, opened from Sign in on smithers.sh" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="dark:sl-hidden" />
<img src="/images/docs/quickstart-sign-in.dark.webp" alt="GitHub's sign-in page, opened from Sign in on smithers.sh" width="1440" height="900" loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="light:sl-hidden" />
</figure>

## Result

You opened a repository on smithers.sh, read a file, and started signing in with GitHub.
